manaNeeded: {2} if you don't control a creature token or {1} otherwise
easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a creature token, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, and The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, if applicable, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Watcher trigger, if applicable, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
If you control a Treasure, activate it by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
